text:
alex: heads-up — spotted intermittent funcall parse errors on the new zephyr-int4 canary. ~2/50 requests fail with trailing garbage after the json array :thinking:

alex: sample from logs:```
{"tool": "search", "args": ["redwood inference"]}
```

maria: ugh. any pattern on prompt length or kv-cache hits?

cheng: looked at the stream boundary. failure cases mostly have batching+kvcache enabled + seqlen > 512. seems like the last token in the stream is getting a non-utf8 byte after quant decode.

eva: metric impact: structured-output compliance dropped 99.1% -> 95.8% on the int4 canary, but floated back on retries. retry success rate ~60% which hurts latency SLO.

tony: could be kernel rounding producing invalid byte sequences that end up in the token->string step. have we repro'd with deterministic seeds?

alex: repro script attached in thread gist (short run). also repros locally when enabling continuous-batch + kv-prefix. not deterministic but more common when throughput > 30 rps.

cheng: quick mitigation ideas:
- add an end-anchor token for funcall payloads (e.g. `<<JSON_END:checksum>>`) and validate checksum before handing to parser
- on parse error, run a small byte-sanitizer to strip non-utf8 tails before retrying parse
- increase retry budget for funcalls from 1->2 for canary only

maria: +1 to anchor token. cheap and doesn't require model changes. we should measure false negatives (model accidentally emits anchor string).

eva: I'll run an evaluation: three arms — baseline, anchor-token, sanitizer+retry. comparing schema-compliance, p99 latency, and extra tokens emitted. planning 5k samples each. assigning to me.

canary-bot: canary update — zephyr-int4 canary live: 12:20 UTC, 5% traffic. current schema-fail-rate: 4.2% (rolling 30m).

tony: implementation notes: put anchor injection in postprompt tooling so it's only on canary runs. PR idea: `platform/serving/postproc/anchor_guard.py` + lightweight checksum (crc32 in base64).

alex: also add telemetry: `emit_fcall_anchor_status` with tags: model, quant, kvcache_hit, batch_size, canary_tag. we need to see correlation.

maria: quick parser fallback we used before that healed similar issues: try `json.loads`, if fails then run `s = s.encode('utf-8', 'ignore').decode('utf-8')` and try again, then attempt NDJSON split and parse last valid object. not ideal but recovers many cases.

eva: test plan: run 5k samples/arm, collect schema-compliance, retry-rate, p99 latency, and number of times sanitizer mutated payload. ETA data by EOD tomorrow. I'll post a short PR with evaluation notebook.

cheng: follow-ups for infra:
- spike to disable kvcache for zephyr-int4 to confirm causality (small canary run)
- collect raw post-kv-decoding bytes for failed requests into secure bucket for debugging (PII-safe: only model bytes)

tony: if anchor approach works, we should roll it to dedicated for a week before making it default. but also open issue with runtime team to trace quant decode -> tokenization boundary for non-utf8 emission.

alex: created ticket INF-9645 and linked the gist and current logs. assigning cheng + eva.

maria: ok. I can prototype anchor injection + parser fallback in `dev` by lunchtime. will tag you all in PR. :white_check_mark:

eva: thanks — will run evals once your PR lands. posting results in this thread. :eyes:
